code: rc = proc_signature_packets (ctrl, NULL, fp, sl, sigfile );
note: The opened file is handed to the packet processor for signature verification.
Verification mode constrains packet handling to signature/cleartext processing.
The parser reads attacker-controlled packets from the signature file one by one.
A cleartext/plaintext packet is dispatched to proc_plaintext, carrying the attacker-controlled literal data.
proc_plaintext builds and processes the cleartext signature state from the packet list and associated metadata.
The function assumes the current list still points to a valid key/signature structure while validating the plaintext signature.
During signature checking, digest state is created and later used together with key material derived from the processed packets.
The packet list and its contained packet objects are released after processing, invalidating pointers held from earlier parsing.
